title: Steinhaus Piercing with Slack: The Exact Asymptotic Constant
summary: Let s(d) be the largest order N for which the first n + d points of a sequence in [0,1) meet every uniform n-cell for all n ≤ N. We prove s(d) = d/(1 − log 2) + O(√d), determining the limit asked for by Anholcer et al. and disproving their conjectured coefficient. For strong piercing, which requires meeting every interval of length 1/n, we obtain an exact finite harmonic capacity and rational constructions.
